newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: RETAIL DEMAND PUSHES VEDIOR TO NEW HIGHS.
newsitem.headline: RETAIL DEMAND PUSHES VEDIOR TO NEW HIGHS.

text.p: Strong retail demand pushed the shares of temporary employment agency Vedior NV to new highs on the Amsterdam bourse on Thursday, dealers said.
At 0825 GMT Vedior shares were up 2.50 guilders or 4.5 percent at 58.50, having traded as high as 58.90 at one point.

A specialist trader in the shares said he already had buy orders from retail customers for 25,000 shares before trading began at 0730 GMT and that further buy orders came in through the morning. Some holders of the shares decided to take profits as they bettered their previous high of 56.50 from yesterday.

Another dealer said Vedior -- recently demerged from retail group Vendex -- still had to prove itself and looked quite fully valued at current levels compared to sector rival Randstad which had a longer bourse track record.
"Randstad's premium over Vedior is beginning to look too small," he said.
